__broaden__.elsen: else- — to submit (stem inferred from the Ming 投降); converb -n, 'submitting' (verb, converb) [投降] · also the noun 'submission' (elsen, Ming 歸附), as in Elsen iregdežü, 'submission having come about'
__broaden__.oro: oro — hollow of the chest, pit of the stomach (noun) [心窩] · also oro- 'to enter' (verb stem, before the split-off converb žu and in oroγad; Ming 入) · also oro 'place, seat, position' (noun; Ming 位子), as in oro-ban 'one's own place' · also 'trace, track' (Ming 痕迹), in oro ügei 'without trace, groundless'
__broaden__.oroqu: oro- — to enter, go over to (Ming 投); participle -qu (verb, participle) [投的] · here also 'to follow, comply' (Ming 從的, with ülüġü-ji 不從的 'those who do not')
__broaden__.orožu: oro- — to enter, to come in; converb [入着] · here also 'following, going along with' (Ming 從着), in eje-dür an-u orožu
